ModMetaData.name: Construction Performance Optimizer
ModMetaData.author: Coolnether123
ModMetaData.description:
Construction Performance Optimizer helps RimWorld stay responsive when your colony has a large construction backlog.
Colonies with hundreds or thousands of blueprints can spend a surprising amount of processing time repeatedly checking unfinished construction. CPO reduces that unnecessary work, allowing the game to spend more time advancing the simulation.
You are most likely to notice the benefit when placing large building plans, maintaining a long construction queue, using terrain-building mods such as Tilled Soil, playing large or late-game colonies with many builders, or running at higher game speeds.
The improvement depends on how much construction is active. It may be substantial in construction-heavy colonies and barely noticeable when little is being built.
CPO improves game performance. It does not make pawns build faster, alter work priorities, skip material delivery, change construction success chances, or bypass final construction authorization.
Supports RimWorld 1.0 through 1.6. RimWorld 1.0 uses only the continuation optimization for compatibility with its older runtime. Single-player is supported on every listed version. Multiplayer is supported only on RimWorld 1.5 and 1.6, and every player must use the same CPO version and mod list.
Requires Harmony. No settings and no save data. Normally safe to add or remove between sessions; keep a normal save backup when changing a large mod list.
